methods.title: Independent annotation and reading agreement
methods.summary: Align named loci and report agreement with uncertainty and adjudication history.
assumptions: Annotators follow a shared protocol; reading lineages are recorded.
controls: Blinded duplicate annotation; chance and prevalence checks; disagreements retained.
limitations: Agreement is not accuracy; converted copies of one reading are not independent witnesses.
methods.cost: CPU-scale initial protocol or small manual evidence audit; declare exact budget before expanding.

methods.title: Bounded cipher-family testing
methods.summary: Specify reversible procedures and test predeclared held-out predictions and failure conditions.
assumptions: Keys, substitutions, exceptions and search domain are fully disclosed.
controls: Known-plaintext recovery; decoy languages; equal search budget and exception penalties.
limitations: Flexible readings and unconstrained anagrams can fit almost anything; historical plausibility needs separate evidence.
methods.cost: CPU-scale initial protocol or small manual evidence audit; declare exact budget before expanding.

methods.title: Clustering and topic-model auditing
methods.summary: Compare text-derived groups to source-specific labels with permutation diagnostics.
assumptions: Features, k, initialization and preprocessing are declared before evaluation.
controls: Label permutations within quire; equal page-length controls; held-out assignment.
limitations: Association is not semantics. Scribe, section, quire and page length can confound each other.
methods.cost: CPU-scale initial protocol or small manual evidence audit; declare exact budget before expanding.

methods.title: Conditional entropy diagnostics
methods.summary: Estimate empirical next-symbol uncertainty under declared token/boundary conventions.
assumptions: Encoded units, sample boundaries and estimator are fixed.
controls: Equal symbol count; boundary and glyph-composition variants; known plaintext and shuffled nulls.
limitations: Finite-sample bias, script differences and genre remain; low entropy is not a decipherment.
methods.cost: CPU-scale initial protocol or small manual evidence audit; declare exact budget before expanding.

methods.title: Frequency and encoded token lengths
methods.summary: Report counts, rank distributions, hapax types and token-length histograms.
assumptions: Token/character conventions are declared and stable.
controls: Matched text lengths, shuffled characters and meaningful prose; sensitivity to spaces.
limitations: Zipf-like curves and length fits cannot identify meaning or a specific language.
methods.cost: CPU-scale initial protocol or small manual evidence audit; declare exact budget before expanding.

methods.title: Pseudotext and mechanism controls
methods.summary: Fit finite generators and compare several held-out diagnostics, not a selected resemblance.
assumptions: Generator family, seed scope and parameter budget are frozen.
controls: Known-language, character-shuffle, copy/mutate and grammar controls; all attempts retained.
limitations: Matching measured statistics does not prove this generator produced the manuscript.
methods.cost: CPU-scale initial protocol or small manual evidence audit; declare exact budget before expanding.

methods.title: Historical constraint and provenance testing
methods.summary: Trace dated ownership, material and textual claims to inspectable primary evidence.
assumptions: Dating methods and source chains have explicit uncertainties.
controls: Competing chronologies; distinguish material date from writing date; named counterevidence.
limitations: Catalogs can repeat obsolete assertions; stylistic resemblance alone does not establish origin.
methods.cost: CPU-scale initial protocol or small manual evidence audit; declare exact budget before expanding.

methods.title: Blinded image-text association
methods.summary: Test proposed associations against independently labeled images and randomized pairing.
assumptions: Rights-cleared images and non-leading annotation criteria are available.
controls: Blinded annotators; decoy images; withheld folios; competing plant identifications.
limitations: Resemblance is subjective; pictures and text could be only loosely related.
methods.cost: CPU-scale initial protocol or small manual evidence audit; declare exact budget before expanding.

methods.title: Held-out sequence models
methods.summary: Fit finite n-gram models and report held-out cross-entropy and parameter count.
assumptions: Training and test partitions are separated before fitting.
controls: Equal tuning budgets; simpler baselines; out-of-quire evaluation.
limitations: Predictive fit does not identify a production mechanism; related pages can leak information.
methods.cost: CPU-scale initial protocol or small manual evidence audit; declare exact budget before expanding.

methods.title: Uncertainty-preserving corpus parsing
methods.summary: Count format violations, alternative readings and token exclusions under explicit policies.

controls: Synthetic malformed and foldout fixtures; raw byte hashes; alternative-space variants.

methods.title: Line position and local repetition
methods.summary: Measure first/last-token length and repeated adjacent-token rates by locus type.

methods.title: Explicit replication and falsification
